fields.description: The house that supplies this variety. A house named here is one the farm can buy from, not one it has committed to: a plan still has to agree what each one brings.
fields.label: Supplier

fields.description: Leave empty where the arrangement holds for every farm. A row naming a farm is that farm's arrangement and beats the blank one for the same house.
fields.label: Farm

fields.description: Order to delivery for this house. A planting week this house cannot reach in time is a week the plan will not propose to it.
fields.label: Lead (weeks)

fields.description: How much of the order this house is promised. Leave the column empty to split it evenly.
fields.label: Share %

fields.description: The smallest order this house accepts, in plants. Zero means it has none on file.
fields.label: Minimum order (plants)

fields.description: The week this house's rhythm starts from, as 2027-W26. Where it is empty the rhythm is counted from the first week the plan could plant, once this house's lead is allowed for.
fields.label: First delivery week

fields.description: Preferred houses are offered first where the plan has to choose.
fields.label: Preferred
